title: Form Studio intake shape (IntakeForm), template excel-template-v1
description: The common shape a Bahmni export or the Excel template becomes before it is built into an O3 form (src/intake/intake-types.ts). Written from those TypeScript types; intake-schema.test.ts keeps the two in step and validates every real Bahmni export and the Excel example against it. Strict: unknown fields are refused, so a drift shows up as a failure.

name.description: Form name (About sheet, or the Bahmni form name)

encounter.description: Encounter type name; one of the project's types

replaces.description: An existing form's name or uuid this rebuilds: its identity (uuid, name, encounter type) is kept

problems.description: Problems found while reading the file

repeat.description: The source lets this block be filled many times (Bahmni allowAddMore on a set)

match.description: A concept chosen on the server, and how it was found

enum: same question in the shipped form

concept.description: A uuid or an exact concept name written in the source

names.description: Other names to try (e.g. the Bahmni concept name behind the label)

cielHint.description: A CIEL id from the source: used only if it exists on the server (no foreign uuids)

type.description: 'group': questions saved together under one set concept (O3 obsGroup); repeat makes it a repeating group

showIf.description: Template rule words: <Question ID> = <option>, <Question ID> has <option>, <Question ID> is answered|empty, age > 5, sex = F

calculation.description: BMI(<height id>, <weight id>), EDD(<LNMP id>), or an engine expression

fromEmr.description: Already in the patient record (name, MRN, age, sex): not built, listed for review

notes.description: Reviewer notes from the source; never built into the form

where.description: Page › Section › Question, or a row number
